cases.scope: Source-shaped refinement of retained-next-round admission: one successful shrink, populations 2..5 and all legal retained prefixes, old-tree publish/unlock/signal and receiver exit, successful retired joins, then retained-tree aggregated upward convergence. The root's receipt of both direct-child aggregates implies completion of every retained sender's old downward calls, not merely those children's local entry. Joins-only negative control represents a proposed unsafe reclamation site, not destruction present in candidate027. Positive uses convergence plus joins before abstract reclamation. Assumes coherent publication, correctly aligned consecutive rounds and no overlapping resize/new admissions. GC is a prior admitted premise, not modeled here. Excludes failed joins, constructor rollback, nested GC, repeated shrink/grow, signals, C memory-model proof, arbitrary cardinality and native acceptance. No runtime destruction hook is implemented.
